sql: SELECT id, status FROM (SELECT sluice_src.id, CASE WHEN sluice_src.status IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE concat(substr(sluice_src.status::varchar, 1, $2), repeat($3, GREATEST((length(sluice_src.status::varchar) - $2) - $4, 0)), substr(sluice_src.status::varchar, GREATEST((length(sluice_src.status::varchar) - $4) + 1, $2 + 1))) END AS status, sluice_src.total FROM pg.public.orders sluice_src WHERE sluice_src.status <> $1) orders WHERE status = 'o***'
